entries.injuryDescription: Recovering from a right ACL tear and February 2026 surgery.
entries.expectedReturnText: Will not be ready to start the season. He is doing very light on-court work, but Golden State has not given a return timetable.
entries.notes: Do not convert the lack of timetable into a guessed return date.

entries.injuryDescription: Recovering from a serious right knee/patellar tendon injury and surgery.
entries.expectedReturnText: Will not be ready to start the season. He is progressing with light on-court work, but there is no firm return timetable.
entries.notes: Current status is materially different from a normal day-to-day training-camp injury.

entries.injuryDescription: Out indefinitely because of an undisclosed health issue.
entries.expectedReturnText: Golden State has not provided a return timetable. He did not travel to Hawaii for the opening of training camp.
entries.notes: Use Unknown rather than inventing a diagnosis or duration.

entries.injuryDescription: Recovering from right heel surgery that also addressed a partially torn Achilles tendon.
entries.expectedReturnText: Will miss the start of the season. The Clippers have not established a timetable for his debut.
entries.notes: No exact return date is supported by the current team update.

entries.injuryDescription: Recovering from surgery to repair a torn left shoulder labrum.
entries.expectedReturnText: Phoenix says he will miss an extended period and has no official return timetable.
entries.notes: Secondary reporting has discussed a multi-month absence, but the official timetable remains open.

entries.injuryDescription: Recovering from surgery to repair a right lateral meniscus tear.
entries.expectedReturnText: Portland said he will be re-evaluated six months after his August 26 surgery, around late February 2027.
entries.notes: Late February is a re-evaluation window, not a guaranteed return date.

entries.injuryDescription: Recovering from surgery for a ruptured Achilles tendon.
entries.expectedReturnText: There is optimism for a late-season return, but he is unlikely to be a meaningful fantasy contributor for most of 2026-27.
entries.notes: No firm return date has been announced.

entries.injuryDescription: Torn right ACL.
entries.expectedReturnText: Expected to miss the entire 2026-27 season.
entries.notes: Season-long absence is explicitly reported.

entries.injuryDescription: Recovering from a torn right ACL suffered in February 2026.
entries.expectedReturnText: Indiana expects a return around the middle of the season, but has not attached an exact date.
entries.notes: Rehab is reported to be on schedule and hitting benchmarks.

entries.injuryDescription: Recovering from surgery to repair a torn left rotator cuff.
entries.expectedReturnText: Will be re-evaluated roughly six months after his August surgery, around late February 2027.
entries.notes: The re-evaluation window is not a guaranteed return date.

entries.injuryDescription: Recovering from a right-foot Lisfranc injury and surgery.
entries.expectedReturnText: The Clippers say he will not be ready for the season opener; no firm return date is available.
entries.notes: Avoid treating an early-November third-party estimate as an official return date.

entries.injuryDescription: Recovering from right knee surgery.
entries.expectedReturnText: No return timetable has been announced; San Antonio is taking a cautious rehab approach.
entries.notes: Current rehab is certain, but the return window remains uncertain.

entries.injuryDescription: Recovering from surgery for a torn ACL.
entries.expectedReturnText: Still in ACL rehabilitation with no reliable current return date.
entries.notes: Do not assume a spring return without a team-issued timetable.

entries.injuryDescription: Returning from ACL reconstruction after missing 2025-26.
entries.expectedReturnText: Fully cleared for practice and five-on-five work; he may begin the season on a minutes restriction and could be managed on back-to-backs.
entries.notes: This is a return-ramp case rather than a current long-term absence.

entries.injuryDescription: Recovering from June surgery to repair a fractured right foot.
entries.expectedReturnText: Beginning camp as a partial participant, with no significant current concern reported about Opening Night availability.
entries.notes: Monitor preseason progression, but current reporting is optimistic for the start of the season.

entries.injuryDescription: Returning after left ankle surgery and a left elbow procedure.
entries.expectedReturnText: Cleared for on-court activity and reported to be on pace for Memphis' October 21 regular-season opener.
entries.notes: Opening-night readiness is the current target, not a guarantee.

entries.injuryDescription: Ramping up after surgery on his right foot.
entries.expectedReturnText: Recovery is progressing, but Dallas plans a limited start to training camp and is emphasizing patience.
entries.notes: No exact Opening Night clearance has been announced.

entries.injuryDescription: Limited in training camp by a currently undisclosed or 'nagging' issue after March right-knee surgery.
entries.expectedReturnText: Training-camp status remains uncertain; there is no reliable current return timetable.
entries.notes: Use Unknown because current reporting does not establish whether the limitation is the surgically repaired knee or another issue.

entries.injuryDescription: Recovering from left ankle surgery performed in January 2026.
entries.expectedReturnText: No clear timetable has been provided; he could open the season inactive and may face minutes/back-to-back restrictions when cleared.
entries.notes: Current readiness is uncertain enough that a firm return label would overstate the evidence.

entries.injuryDescription: Left hamstring injury suffered during offseason on-court activity.
entries.expectedReturnText: Will miss the preseason and be re-evaluated during the first week of the regular season; Opening Night availability is uncertain.
entries.notes: This is a short-term but currently meaningful injury; remove or downgrade promptly once he is cleared.
